ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white/off-white) and 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white geometric zones located on the lateral lobes, separated by a central low-intensity vertical column. High-frequency mottled transitions (pixel speckling) are visible at the interfaces of high and low intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitudes of variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory following a parabolic arc from the median notch to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-relief, high-contrast circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, vertically oriented dark pixel tracks visible on the white pigment of the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified protrustions at the distal tips of both lobes, disrupting the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated dark focal spots located within the interior white field of the right lobe.
